column1: # .claude/state/auto_merge_tier2.tsv -- llm#1471
# ONE home for the Auto-Merge Tier 2 classes, read by bin/auto_merge_sweep.sh.
# Tier 2 is a bounded, conservative window of automation for low-risk, testable
# script changes that the exclusion list would otherwise keep owner-verb only
# (it relaxes ONLY the scheduled-script reason; every path in
# auto_merge_exclusions.txt stays excluded, and every path in
# auto_merge_tier2_hardnever.txt stays owner-verb).
# A PR opts in with a trailer line in its body:  Tier-2-Class: <class>
# The trailer is only a claim. The mechanical conditions below are the real
# gate: all of them, plus every normal auto-merge condition, plus a 4 h veto
# window (head commit and checks green for >= 4 h, no owner veto) and a cap of
# 2 Tier 2 merges per UTC day.
# Columns (TAB separated; '#' lines and blank lines are ignored):
#   class                 name used in the Tier-2-Class trailer and in merge_events (tier2:<class>)
#   max_changed_lines     additions + deletions of the whole PR must not exceed this
#   required_path_globs   ';'-separated shell globs; EVERY changed path (and every
#                         previous path of a rename) must match one of them
#   forbidden_extra       extra ERE no changed path may match, or '-' for none
#   requires_tests        1 = at least one changed file under tests/ or .claude/tests/
#                         (a lone edit of tests/ci_test_map.tsv does not count)
#   enabled               1 = usable, 0 = switched off (the rollback: set it to 0)
# Class readonly-checker is special: besides the columns below, the code requires
# every changed path that is not a test file to be listed in
# .claude/state/readonly_checkers.txt (owner-signed; see that file) and the sweep
# runs tests/test_readonly_checkers_guard.sh --scan on the PR-head content of each
# changed script. Any other scheduled script keeps the scheduled-script reason.
# Class scheduled-script (llm#1471, owner-approved 2026-10-20): scripts run by a
# launchd job may merge under Tier 2 EXCEPT those whose file name says they close,
# delete, reap, garbage-collect, reload, purge, prune or kill things, or touch
# credentials, secrets or rotation (the forbidden_extra regex below: a name
# deny-list, so a destructive scheduled script stays the owner's verb, the reason
# the scheduled-script exclusion exists, #1274), plus everything on the hard-never
# list (private_terms_publish.sh, scanner triage, the schema, the sweep, the
# classifier, the merge history). Launchd plists and recorders are hard-never.
# Class state-table (llm#1471, owner-approved 2026-10-20): a PR whose only
# .claude/state/ changes are to files on the owner-signed allow-list
# .claude/state/auto_merge_state_tables.txt, and that ONLY ADDS lines to them (a
# deleted line, an edit, a rename or a delete is owner-verb). The code requires
# every changed path that is not a test file to be on that list. Any other state
# file, and the list itself, stay excluded and hard-never.
# Widening is Class C (explicit "merge"): editing this table, the hard-never list
# or the AGENTS.md paragraph that describes them.
